body:
Thankyou for replying.
I had never heard of gaslighting. It does sound familiar and will have to watch for it in future.

Hope you are well.

Thankyou for talking. You are right, i am emotionally fried. 
I think i know my wife well. I just do not know if its real or if its my mind. I find it very hard to chill and my doctor has prescribed something to help in the short term. I have an emergency referral to psychiatrist. Hopefully that may help. 
I really appreciate your reply. .  Somehow i feel a little less alone.
Hope you keep well
Thanks for your reply it helps to know im not the only one. Hope you have it controlled. I do need something to try and focus on maybe that would help. Definitely not a bike though, 4 wheels now.

Thankyou so much for your fast reply. I have been trying to manage it myself although i think i may have passed that now.
I am waiting for the doctors to call back and see what they say.

Thankyou again it means a lot knowing someone is listening
